description: Deeper trust check before paying an x402 endpoint ($0.05 Exact USDC). Runs the same live 402 + history as preflight_check, then repeated probes for payTo/price consistency, a recent public Base USDC-to-payTo transfer sample, Bazaar + 402 Index listing checks, and drift vs last KV history. Does not claim OFAC or wallet simulation. Optional when the base check is not enough signal.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the x402 seller endpoint (the resource you are about to pay)

name: deep_check
